segments.sn28.3:1.2: Addasā kho āyasmā ānando … pe …“vippasannāni kho te, āvuso sāriputta, indriyāni;
segments.sn28.3:2.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi; yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn28.3:2.2: Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn28.3:2.3: ‘ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā ‘ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ‘ahaṃ tatiyā jhānā vuṭṭhito’ti vā”ti.
segments.sn28.3:2.4: “Tathā hi panāyasmato sāriputtassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā.
segments.sn28.3:2.5: Tasmā āyasmato sāriputtassa na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn28.3:2.6: ‘ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā ‘ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ‘ahaṃ tatiyā jhānā vuṭṭhito’ti vā”ti.
